exposure: Robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy with four equally-spaced ports (RA-TLH/4e) without an assistant port
Robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy with four unequally-spaced ports (RA-TLH/4u)
Conventional robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy with five ports (RA-TLH/5)
cohort: The study participants were patients undergoing robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
finding: Robot-assisted total laparoscopic hysterectomy with four equally-spaced ports (RA-TLH/4e) is a highly useful technique that excels in safety, reduces costs and personnel, and effectively compensates for the lack of an assistant port through port-hopping.
